title: Simple and Cool Modpack!
description: Some QoL with a side of entertaining mods. There is 68 mods (including optimization) but even my potato laptop gets 60 fps at 8 chunks!
body: Hello y'all! I am installing mods to my potato laptop for like 6 years right now and none of the modpacks work properly on my laptop except optimization modpacks ofc. So I always made modpacks on my own. Here is my first published one in 6 years. It enhances survival experience but not just with **QoL (Quality of Life)** mods even with mods such as _Traveler's Backpack_, _Farmer's Delight_ and _Effortless Building_. It adds features like **backpacks**, **armor stand arms**, **ambient sounds**, **optimization**,**more crops**,**more food**, **blueprints and more!** Check it out! Only for 1.21.11 just for now.
